title: Ag-W v5 exploratory 300 K pilot readiness
scope: This screen is less demanding than a quantitative interface-validation study. It still requires a numerically stable, non-collapsed starting structure before thermal motion is added.

checks.minimum_distances_after_EFS: FAIL: W-W 2.440 A, Ag-Ag 2.295 A, Ag-W 2.434 A

decision: Do not use the v5 EFS-relaxed structure for a 300 K no-source pilot. A separate exploratory gate permits approximate physics, but this candidate still has severe local collapse and did not converge.
